It offers the same tone as the original, but with added features for more flexibility. It includes a tone bypass and a switch that allows you to select between scooped, flat, or hump mids. The pedal uses NOS BC239C transistors and high-quality metal film resistors and capacitors to ensure a vintage tone with minimal noise. The Large Beaver has become the go-to choice for vintage Muff Clones due to its accurate tone and versatile controls. Summary created by AI from the original source.
